I'll use "Measurement transducer".
- Type designations: Promass Q 300 DNxxx, Promass Q 500 DNxxx
- Module designation: null or "Not applicable"? The schema says "Analog load cell" | "Not applicable" | null. Since this is not a load cell, I'll omit or set null. Let me set null (or omit).

Model family: Cert covers 2 model variants: Promass Q 300 and Promass Q 500. Also there's sensor size axis: DN25, DN50, DN80, DN100. Hmm. The Table 1 is for the Promass Q measurement sensor with sizes DN25-DN100. So the models are Promass Q 300 DN25, DN50, DN80, DN100 and Promass Q 500 DN25, DN50, DN80, DN100? Actually the transmitter types are Promass 300 and Promass 500 electronics; sensor sizes DN25...DN100.

The footnote says: "With xxx denoting the size of the Promass Q measurement sensor."

So the certified types: Promass Q 300 DNxxx; Promass Q 500 DNxxx where xxx ∈ {25, 50, 80, 100}.
